items.q: How far in advance can I book?
items.a: Up to six months. We do book up — most Saturday nights are spoken for 4–8 weeks out. Weekday evenings are usually easier.
The full space (after 5 PM weekdays, all day weekends), tables & chairs reconfigured to your needs, A/V (a small projector + speakers), and a host on-site for the duration.
Yes. We offer a coffee bar, a light-bites package, or full menus from a small list of partner kitchens. Or you can bring your own — just tell us.
Yes, but it’s reasonable. Weeknights start at $400; weekend evenings at $900. We’ll quote based on your details.
BYOB with a small corkage. We can also coordinate a bartender via a partner — ask in the form.
Full refund up to 14 days before. After that, we’ll work with you to reschedule or refund what we reasonably can.
